messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: hosted-api eu-west alert — request queue climbing fast. pending=5.8k, p95=3.4s, p99=19.2s, GPU util ~99% on pool-gpu-eu-west. Autoscaler reported failures. Pager: @sanjay

sanjay: oncall ack. pulling autoscaler logs and instance create errors now.

megan: autoscaler shows repeated "CreateVM failed: QuotaExceeded" from provider. Retries then exponential backoff.

dave: traffic source looks like tenant=holiday-blitz-marketing fanout — dozens of concurrent campaigns. Massive single-tenant spike.

erin: support is seeing elevated 504/timeout spikes for a handful of high-volume customers, noted in support-dashboard.

carol: ingress timeouts set to 20s — queued requests are hitting that and surfacing as p99 in the metrics.

sanjay: immediate plan: 1) enact tenant-scoped emergency throttles for non-SLA keys 2) enable cross-region spill to eu-central 3) apply best-effort model fallback (redwood-small-quant) for free-tier 4) attempt manual capacity add in eu-west

megan: manual GPU provisioning in eu-west failing with same quota error. Cloud support ticket opened (Q-114572) for emergency quota bump.

dave: we can do a routing canary to eu-central where quota is available. frontend-proxy supports region canaries; can flip 30% in ~2m.

sanjay: flip it. also enable short TTL KV_PREFIX_CACHE on common prompt prefixes to drop duplicate decoding. set KV_PREFIX_CACHE=90s for /v1/chat and /v1/generate.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: frontend-proxy@canary -> route 30% traffic to eu-central. ci: ci-110442.

megan: infra note: autoscaler error is explicit: "Project GPU quota exhausted (requested 4, available 0)". Support ticket in progress.

carol: temporary rate-limit rule pushed for non-SLA and trial keys: 6 rps, burst 12. YAML snippet applied.

erin: sending targeted customer notices to impacted accounts with ETA 20-40m for recovery, Ops & AMs looped in.

sanjay: early results: p95 dropped to 2.0s, p99 to ~10.5s, queue ~1.9k. Routing canary + rate-limits helping.

dave: also enabling model_variant_fallback chain for best-effort traffic: [redwood-medium, redwood-small-quant]. This is lowering GPU memory pressure and speeding throughput.

megan: cloud approved temporary +6 GPUs in eu-west for 2 hours. Manual provisioning completed; new nodes joined pool-gpu-eu-west.

incident-bot: Update: pool expansion succeeded. pending=280, p95=1.0s, p99=2.6s.

erin: support update sent: majority restored, minor transient errors remain; offering follow-up check-ins.

carol: follow-ups for postmortem: - autoscaler should detect quotaDenial and trigger circuit-breaker (stop aggressive retries) - automated cross-region spillover runbook - tenant-level early throttles for high-fanout campaigns - verify ingress timeout vs queue expiry

sanjay: notes for handoff to @megan in 30m — commands used below and saved: 
```
# canary 30% -> eu-central
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routing/canary -d '{"region":"eu-central","pct":30}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# apply trial key limiter
kubectl apply -f /ops/limits/trial-rate-limit.yaml
```

megan: filing INFRA-4521: autoscaler-quota-circuit-breaker + cross-region spill automation. I will be on the next hour then hand to overnight oncall.

dave: recommendation: add tenant-fanout detection in edge-proxy to auto-apply protective throttles for campaigns (thresholds + cooloffs), and record tenant score for routing priorities.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: degraded host performance improved and queue drained. Monitoring for 60 minutes for closure. :white_check_mark:
